task.title: Explain Commits with AI
task.shortdesc: Use the Git History view to generate an AI summary of the changes introduced by a selected commit.

context.p: If you want a quick summary of all changes made in a particular commit, you can use the Explain commit action in the Git History view. This is useful when the commit message alone does not provide enough detail or when you want a faster overview before reviewing the affected files.

step.cmd: Open the Git History view for the current repository.
Right-click the commit that you want to understand.
Review the AI-generated explanation of the selected commit.

result.p: The AI generates a summary of the selected commit so you can understand what changed before you inspect the affected files in detail.

postreq.p: You can customize how commit explanations are generated in the Git Client AI preferences. For example, you can add project-specific instructions and save them in an project file so the same guidance is shared across a team.
